name: slider
title: Slider
description: A knob in a groove that never leaves it, a green fill to the knob's centre, notches and labelled ticks on the same travel; three sizes, glyphs at the ends, full width or a set width, and a value readout on the drum. A range (two knobs), vertical, detents, a centred fill, an ink tone and a value bubble while dragging; it mirrors right to left. Arrows step, Shift steps large.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/slider.md. SwiftUI: MetalSlider in the MetalUI Swift package.
